conviction_note: No pre-release and no guidance line (Votum does not guide), so the move is about the Q3 numbers themselves against a single-analyst FY bar (DM BOS 106.0m net for 2026, implying ~49m for H2). The only directional evidence is inference: on 19 Nov the board, which already had Q3 books, declared a second interim dividend, and PKO BP's Q3 legal-risk charge rose on higher settlement costs. That gives a mild lean up (p_up 55) on a thin name whose numbers are new (abs 6.0, scaled +0.6). The findings sum (+1.2) is larger than the scaled number because each inference is sized on its own; the gap is the 2024 Q3 print day (-10.7%) and a reaction history that does not reward beats reliably. The unexplained -8% drop at 16:15 CET on 19 Nov, on ~6x normal volume, sits in neither number: an unexplained drawdown is worth 0.

The only bar is DM BOS's FY2026 forecast (net 106.0m, revenue 427.0m; one analyst, report of 2026-10-12, https://www.biznesradar.pl/storage/a/vo/t-/vot-bos-2026-10-12-pwpa-4ce8dbe.pdf), which against H1 actuals of 56.9m net / 217.9m revenue implies about 49m net and 209m revenue for H2. findings.finding: On 19 Nov 2026, five days before the print and with Q3 books closed, management declared a second interim dividend for 2026 of 1.50 PLN/share (18m PLN). That takes 2026 interims to 4.00 PLN (48m) against 3.34 PLN in 2025 (1.67 + 1.67). A board facing a weak Q3 would be unlikely to raise its cash return.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 prints moved -10.7% (2024-11-25) and about +0.7% / -2.2% around 2025-11-21. The dividend announcement itself lifted the price 37.1 -> 37.7 in the 15:30 bar on 19 Nov before an unrelated-looking collapse at 16:15.
findings.original_quote: podjął uchwałę o przedłożeniu Radzie Nadzorczej wniosku dotyczącego wypłaty akcjonariuszom drugiej zaliczki na poczet dywidendy za 2026 rok w kwocie 18 000 000,00 zł (...) na jedną akcję będzie przypadać kwota 1,50 zł
findings.why_not_priced: Read as a dividend, the stock got it: +1.6% in the 15:30 bar. Read as a signal about Q3, it has not been priced: the stock closed the day 8% lower and fell another 2% on 20 Nov, which it would not have done if the market had taken the declaration as evidence of a solid Q3. Caveat that shrinks it: the formal basis is the audited H1 statements, not Q3.

findings.finding: PKO BP, the largest CHF counterparty (about 29k suits), booked a preliminary Q3 2026 legal-risk cost of 371m PLN, up from 297m in Q2, citing among other things a higher estimated cost of settlements. Bank settlements are Votum's main revenue route, so this points to settlement flow holding up in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed VOT reaction to a bank provision series; a counterparty proxy.
findings.original_quote: Wysokość kosztów wynika przede wszystkim z utworzenia rezerwy będącej efektem aktualizacji parametrów modelu oceny ryzyka prawnego oraz wzrostu szacowanego kosztu zawieranych ugód.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody bridges a bank's provision filing to a 120k-USD-a-day claims manager. The one broker note predates it by a day and models H2 at about 24.5m net a quarter. If the link were priced, VOT would not have fallen 16% in 20 sessions while the provision rose. This is a proxy, though: a bigger provision can also mean a larger stock of cases rather than more cases settled in the quarter.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 sector provisions were 3x lower y/y (Parkiet, 2026-07-14), so the Q3 rise at PKO runs against that trend: https://www.parkiet.com/banki/art44816161-franki-juz-nie-martwia-bankow-teraz-problem-to-skd

findings.finding: The bar is low against what management has said. DM BOS's FY2026 net of 106.0m implies about 49m for H2, or roughly 24.5m a quarter, against Q2's 29.4m (which beat the broker by 11%). Management told the broker that quarterly revenue above 100m PLN should persist, which at Q2's 26% net margin is about 26m or more.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat by 11%: the stock was +1.8% the next session, with the dividend announcement landing the same day. Q1 2026 (Q1 revenue -14% y/y) was -2.7% on the report day. Q3 2024 was -10.7%.
findings.original_quote: Zarząd podkreśla, że przychody kwartalne przekraczające 100 mln zł powinny utrzymywać się jeszcze przez pewien czas, choć w dłuższej perspektywie oczekuje ich stopniowej normalizacji.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is at 34.5 against a 46.25 reference in the broker note, a P/E of about 4x on the broker's 2026 number. Since the note it has fallen 25% (roughly 5 points of that is the 2.5 PLN ex-dividend) with no new company information on earnings. The price is discounting more than the broker's bar. Caveats that shrink it: costs rose 6% y/y in H1 on SKD marketing, and Q3 was a record SKD-intake quarter, which costs money before it earns success fees; Q3 is also seasonally the weakest quarter (Q3 2025: 98.4m revenue).

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly up, the same way as the free control (-run_up_20d is positive after a -15.85% run-up), but they rest on company and counterparty documents, not on the run-up. Nothing found explains the 19 Nov collapse, so the run-up may carry information this hunt does not have.
language_note: Everything load-bearing came from Polish sources; English search returned nothing usable on this name.
The second interim dividend (ESPI 42/2026), the board resignation (41/2026) and the EGM agenda with its statute changes (43/2026) exist only in Polish ESPI text and PDFs.
DM BOS's 12 Oct report (the only broker, and the only bar) is Polish-only. It carries the management quote on quarterly revenue staying above 100m PLN and the Q3 record SKD intake.
PKO BP's Q3 legal-risk current report and its reason ('wzrost szacowanego kosztu zawieranych ugod') was read in Polish.
The fact that the H1 report went out after the close (17:16) while earlier quarterly reports came in the morning comes from Polish wire timestamps, and it is what leaves the session unsettled.
lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' / numbers new, not pre-released: abs_move_pct raised from 4.5 to 6.0 on a thin name whose Q3 numbers are new; the 2.05% history median is an estimated-cadence lower bound and is no longer treated as a scale
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series' / proxy weight: the PKO BP counterparty finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3

'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the unsourced bar: the dividend-signal finding cut from +0.5 to +0.4, the bar finding from +0.6 to +0.5, print_vs_bar_pct from +5 to +4, and p_up from 56 to 55 (Q3 2024 print day was -10.7%)
'Open session_check with the verdict only when you have a timestamp': left it opening with 'probable', because only prior-period timestamps exist and the H1 report went out after the close
'The drawdown has no cause in the filings is worth 0': confirmed leaving the 19 Nov 16:15 collapse unsized
